comment: Parameters 26 and 27, Ghost Notes and Accent, are configured but have no ParamWidget and are never read, so they get no line, no tag and no props. Inputs 22, 24, 26 and 28, the second external audio input of each role, are declared and read at src/UniRhythm.cpp:2286-2292 but have no PortWidget on the panel, so no click can reach them and nothing can be patched into them. Each role runs two voices and the audio output carries whichever fired last (src/UniRhythm.cpp:2296-2300), which is the Primary-priority merge the maker names in the module's summary. The gate, pitch and velocity outputs are likewise one set per role rather than one per voice. The poly output lays the four roles out as four channels each, audio, gate, pitch and velocity envelope, which is the layout Portal expects. The isolator's gain law is a squared taper below centre reaching silence and a straight line above it to a gain of four, which is +12dB. The panel prints CLOCK, RESET, REGEN, VARI, HUMAN, SWING, REST, FILL, ARTICULATION, SPREAD, then STYLE, DENSITY, LENGTH, FREQ, DECAY, MIX and EXT IN in each role block, Audio, Gate, Pitch, Velo and MIX over the output rows, LOW, MID, HIGH, DRIVE over the master knobs and POLY over the poly jack. Lettering is drawn in code at src/UniRhythm.cpp:2841-2976.
